wineGlass.evidenceText: Tapas del Gòtic has eight red-wine-by-glass prices but no glass volume. Aangan Restaurant gives only two 15 cl red/house or Rioja options. Tiflis Barcelona explicitly labels 150 ml but its dry red wines are bottle-only; the only 150 ml red shown is a semi-sweet Kindzmarauli, which is excluded. FIRE lists three red-by-glass prices but no volume. No single exact-city public menu supplied at least three qualifying dry-red wines with explicit 125–175 ml or 15 cl volume.
wineGlass.referencePeriod: Returned pages publicly retrieved 2026-08-01; Tapas del Gòtic menu last modified 27 October 2025.
wineGlass.searchQuery: Barcelona Spain restaurant wine list standard pour 15cl red wine price
wineGlass.reason: not_found: qualifying volume and dry-red count were not jointly present in one exact-city menu; unspecified-volume, bottle-only, and semi-sweet entries were not substituted.
